description: Which way is NVDA pointing on each timeframe? Which way one stock points on each timeframe, and whether the timeframes agree. New: its graded record begins with its first publish. One stock's Coil technical rating, free sample: its daily (1D) verdict on a five-step scale (STRONG_UP, UP, NEUTRAL, DOWN, STRONG_DOWN), the swing summary (1h to 1D: the verdict and how many of those timeframes agree, as "k of n aligned") and the market leg of its why, which is one market read shared by every name. New: the rating's thresholds are being graded and its record begins with its first publish. Covers any S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 or macro name, one symbol per call; unknown symbols return the valid-symbol directory; a name that is not rated yet says so. Withheld from the sample: every other timeframe, the day and position summaries and the invalidation. Research, not advice. Free sample: one symbol per call, the 1D verdict, the swing summary and the market leg, from the morning read.
name: get_technical_rating
